searchText: > Rename baseFee to baseFeePerGas Why? Was there any discussion preceding this? It seems blatantly wrong to me I agree that we haven't discussed it or included it in previous renamings, though I *do* like `baseFeePerGas` better (because I like being explicit and including units in variable names to avoid confusion to future developers). However, since we *haven't* discussed it previously we should either have that discussion or stick with the current name being used everywhere I think. Actually, I withdraw my complaint, because the eip does say `base_fee_per_gas` in the block description. I thought it didn't Oh, huh. I must be mis-remembering. The rename is because of the spec https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/blob/master/json-rpc/spec.json#L1489-L1492 Besu works through json rpc How about statetests, they have `currentBaseFee` -- is that also changed to `currentBaseFeePerGas`? <@!393119312350543872> No. Since that is a state test format it is not changed Ok FWIW, we agreed to use `baseFeePerGas` in JSON RPC, as well as the other terms from the EIP. I'm not sure how tests and JSON RPC interact though 😅 There is retesteth + rpc that runs tests using standard rpc and a couple test_ methods
